baseline_models.focus_anchor: The request at word 1, the doubled descent and surah construction at words 5-9, the firm unit at word 10, the fighting mention at words 11-13, and the visible response at words 14-25.
baseline_models.mechanism: A spoken request volunteers readiness for revelation. Once a firmly fixed textual unit arrives and reciprocal combat is brought into speech, the request becomes self-testing: impaired resolve is no longer hidden in the heart but is shown through a death-covered gaze.

activation_trace.role: Audible speech makes the opening wish a public commitment rather than an unexpressed preference.
The requested material is actually conveyed to the hearers, converting anticipation into encounter.
Firm construction removes the looseness in which a request could remain merely aspirational.
Combat need only be voiced within the unit for the latent response to surface.
The cited demand is reciprocal armed encounter, supplying the concrete pressure on professed readiness.
Seeing also makes evident: the inward condition is rendered publicly legible.
Illness weakens an undertaking and shortens movement, explaining the collapse between request and action.
A covering of awareness supplies the bodily endpoint through which the hidden weakness becomes visible.

changed_reading.before: Believers ask for a surah, while people with diseased hearts fear its command to fight.
changed_reading.after: The request itself volunteers a claim of readiness; delivery of the fixed command turns that claim into an exposure event, with impaired resolve becoming visible before any fighting begins.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The repeated surah at words 6 and 9, its qualification at word 10, and combat located inside it at words 11-13.
baseline_models.mechanism: The surah can be imagined as an elevated, bounded unit, while firmness supplies both secure construction and restraint. Combat is not an unbounded atmosphere around the verse; it is placed inside a delimited verbal enclosure whose clarity checks evasive motion.

activation_trace.role: A surah is a bounded portion of discourse, giving the demand a defined textual perimeter.
The raised enclosure image sharpens the sense that the hearer is confronted by a command with visible limits.
Firmness restrains corrupt motion, assigning the unit a corrective blocking function.
The bridle-like branch makes the command a check on flight or uncontrolled movement; this is a material analogy, not a lexical substitution.
Reciprocal combat is the bounded unit's specific pressure rather than a free-floating celebration of death.

changed_reading.before: A clear surah simply issues an alarming command.
changed_reading.after: A delimited and restraining unit fixes combat inside an explicit frame; the recoil is partly a reaction to losing verbal room for evasion.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The attribution of faith at word 3 is set against hearts, disease, fixed looking, covering, and death at words 17-25.
baseline_models.mechanism: Faith carries trust and cardiac settling, but the later heart is out of health and loses effective movement. The verse therefore stages an inversion of the expected bodily effect of belief: a vocabulary of security opens onto a gaze overtaken by mortality.

activation_trace.role: Faith supplies an expectation of inward security and settled trust against which the later response is measured.
The heart is the interior site where the expected security should be held.
Departure from health marks the interior as off balance rather than simply uninformed.
A glance can leave pallor or defect visible, carrying interior disequilibrium onto the face.
Loss of force and life supplies the extreme opposite of secure, mobile commitment.

changed_reading.before: The verse contrasts believers with hypocrites who happen to be afraid.
changed_reading.after: The focus is a somatic inversion of faith's expected security: a heart unable to hold trust converts a verbal profession into visible loss of force.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The final words at word 26 follow the deathlike gaze without an explicit focus-ayah predicate that settles all of their force.
baseline_models.mechanism: The closing root can signal nearness as well as priority or deservingness. Focus-only reading therefore leaves several live possibilities: consequence has drawn near, a judgment is deserved, or the phrase opens an evaluation whose preferable alternative remains unstated here.

activation_trace.role: Nearness lets the ending intensify the death simile as an approaching consequence.
Priority and deservingness keep open an evaluative reading: something is fitter or more due to them.

changed_reading.before: The ending is a fully settled malediction.
changed_reading.after: The ending is also a hinge among nearness, deserved consequence, and what would be more fitting, so its force need not be collapsed before context is read.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier combat sequence gives the focus mention a regulated temporal shape: encounter and fighting pass into binding, release or ransom, and eventually the lowering of war's burdens. This revises the bounded-command baseline from mere textual closure into a phased procedure with stopping and release conditions.

activation_trace.role: The bounded discourse unit provides the focus anchor for importing a delimited sequence rather than an unlimited war atmosphere.
Firm construction supports reading the combat material as determinate and ordered.
The meeting of opposed sides supplies the entry point of the combat procedure.
The same combat root identifies a reciprocal encounter and directly links the earlier procedure to the focus mention.
Binding marks a post-encounter phase and prevents the model from reducing the sequence to killing alone.
Uncompensated release supplies one explicit exit from captivity.
Ransoming a captive supplies the alternative release path.
Lowering what has been carried gives the procedure a terminal movement.
War's burdens name the load that is eventually set down, functioning as a stopping boundary.

structural_cues: 47:4 orders encounter, force, restraint, two release options, and cessation in a single temporal chain before 47:20 later mentions combat.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the phased chain and the repeated combat root; I infer that this chain gives the firm focus unit procedural limits. A live alternative is that 47:20 invokes obligation generally without importing every phase of 47:4.

changed_reading.before: The firm surah announces an undifferentiated command to fight.
changed_reading.after: Its combat mention recalls a bounded procedure containing encounter, restraint, release, and cessation; the hearers recoil from determinate obligation, not from limitless violence.

context_deltas.mechanism: Earlier context names interhuman pressure as a test, opposes supported and steadied feet to aversion toward what descends, and depicts that aversion as collapsing deeds. The focus bodily reaction is therefore diagnostic evidence generated by an ordeal, strengthening the baseline exposure model.

activation_trace.role: Impaired resolve is the latent focus condition that the contextual ordeal can expose.
Testing that makes a condition appear supplies the causal frame for the focus revelation event.
Mutual support supplies the positive response against which recoil is measured.
Strengthening and fixing movement forms the bodily counterimage to the deathlike stare.
Aversion to an object names a plausible hidden affect beneath the focus response.
The same conveyed-down material connects aversion directly to the focus request and arrival.
Collapse and falling give the aversion an outcome beyond momentary emotion.

structural_cues: 47:4 names testing, 47:7 promises steadied feet, and 47:9 joins hatred to what was sent down; the focus then reverses request into bodily failure.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies testing, steadiness, aversion, descent, and collapse; I infer that the focus descent activates a test whose observable result is the gaze. Fear without settled aversion remains a live alternative, so the response alone does not prove a fixed identity.

changed_reading.before: The deathlike look is an incidental emotional reaction to warfare.
changed_reading.after: The look is evidence produced by a test: descent distinguishes supported steadiness from an aversion that weakens action and can undo prior work.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context first directs looking toward historical outcomes, names protective alliance, and supplies a comparative scene of ultimate destinations. Against that expanded horizon, the focus gaze contracts onto the messenger as though death were already present; immediate threat occludes consequence, protection, and comparison.

activation_trace.role: Directed sight is the focus anchor whose field of attention can widen or contract.
Loss of life fills the narrowed visual field with the nearest possible endpoint.
Looking is earlier directed outward as examination and learning, providing the wider visual task that the focus gaze fails.
The final part and outcome of a course gives proper looking a temporal horizon beyond the immediate command.
Protective support supplies an available relation that the death-saturated gaze does not register.
An exemplary sign invites comparison of ends, further widening the horizon against which the focus fixation appears deficient.

structural_cues: 47:10 commands outcome-oriented looking; 47:11 distinguishes who has protective relation; 47:15 makes destinations comparable; 47:20 narrows looking to the addressee and death.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two uses of looking plus outcome, protection, and comparison; I infer a contrast between wide consequential vision and threat fixation. The live alternative is a purely involuntary stare with no critique of attentional horizon.

changed_reading.before: They stare at the messenger because they fear dying in battle.
changed_reading.after: Their gaze displays contracted moral time: immediate mortality fills perception so completely that historical outcome, protective relation, and longer consequence disappear.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediate lead-in distinguishes acoustic access from effective uptake: some listen, depart, ask what was just said, and bear stamped hearts, while later remembrance arrives too late. Thus the focus passive 'is mentioned' is not mere content delivery; it is an uptake event in which heard wording either settles into action or exposes a heart that cannot retain its force.

activation_trace.role: A reminder should restore an item to active presence, making failed uptake more than failed hearing.
The heart is the focus site where a heard reminder either becomes operative or fails.
Hearing can include comprehension and compliance, defining the uptake that the listeners' later question puts in doubt.
A sealing impression supplies a mechanism by which sound reaches a person without becoming available commitment.
The repeated interior organ connects the failed listeners directly to the focus diagnosis.
Sudden arrival removes the extra time on which deferred uptake depends.
Remembrance after arrival supplies the too-late counterpart to the focus mention that should work now.

structural_cues: 47:16 moves from listening to departure and a question about what was said; 47:18 places recollection after sudden arrival; 47:20 makes a specific mention precipitate visible response.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies listening, sealing, delayed remembrance, and the focus mention; I infer that the mention tests retention-to-action, not audibility alone. A live alternative is ordinary confusion rather than resistant uptake.

changed_reading.before: People understand a combat command and then become afraid.
changed_reading.after: The mention tests whether heard revelation can remain present as actionable knowledge; the deathlike gaze is a visible failure of uptake at the point of cost.

context_deltas.mechanism: The next ayah can supply the missing evaluative content of the focus close: pliant obedience and recognizably good speech are fitter for them, especially once the matter hardens into decision and spoken truth must become fulfilled action. This preserves, rather than forces, a syntactic linkage across the ayah boundary.

activation_trace.role: Fittingness and priority make the focus close capable of introducing a preferable response.
Willing compliance supplies the first candidate for what is fitter than the deathlike recoil.
A spoken response mirrors the focus opening request and allows the two kinds of speech to be compared.
Recognizably good conduct qualifies the replacement speech as socially and morally sound.
A heart-bound decision marks the threshold where words can no longer remain costless wishes.
Fulfilling a pledge converts verbal truth into enacted truth at that threshold.
Beneficial preference explicitly completes the evaluative direction opened by the focus ending.

structural_cues: 47:20 ends with an evaluative expression; 47:21 opens with two nominative response terms and later states that truthfulness at decision would be better for them.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies adjacency, fittingness, obedience, speech, resolved decision, enacted truth, and betterment; I infer a possible cross-ayah completion. The materially live alternative is that 47:20 ends in threat and 47:21 begins an independent prescription.

changed_reading.before: The focus ending only pronounces doom on the frightened group.
changed_reading.after: The ending may open a counterfactual prescription: obedient action and sound speech would be fitter, and truth begins when the desired command becomes a decided matter.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus figures visually face the messenger, but the following sequence repeatedly supplies turning away, backs, locked hearts, and retrogression after guidance. Their stare can therefore be a paradoxical orientation: the face remains directed toward the addressee while agency is already retreating.

activation_trace.role: Mutual facing supplies the visible front of a relation that later directional roots can contradict.
Turning away supplies the ethical motion hidden beneath continued visual orientation.
Looking into consequences supplies the deliberative movement that a locked heart fails to perform.
Closure and hardness explain how a facing gaze can coexist with inward non-entry.
Retrogression makes the latent retreat a directional reversal rather than mere immobility.
The back image materializes withdrawal from what the eyes still face.
Gentle direction establishes the path from which the backward movement departs.

structural_cues: 47:20 fixes eyes toward the messenger; 47:22 introduces a disputed directional verb; 47:24 asks for deliberation; 47:25 explicitly places backs after guidance became clear.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies facing, heart closure, backs, and retrogression; I infer that the stare externalizes agency beginning to turn away. The live alternative is the other branch of 47:22, taking authority, which is retained separately rather than resolved here.

changed_reading.before: The gaze is a static facial expression of fear.
changed_reading.after: The gaze is directional contradiction: they still face the messenger bodily while commitment has begun to move backward from clarified guidance.

context_deltas.mechanism: A distinct reading of the following disputed verb is assumption of charge rather than retreat. On that branch, the focus is not only about private cowardice: a diseased interior that fails a costly command can scale outward, if entrusted with affairs, into damaged land and severed kin relations.

activation_trace.role: The heart localizes the initially private condition that may later acquire public reach.
Departure from right functioning supplies the defect that the authority reading can amplify.
Taking charge of an affair supplies the social transmission mechanism from inner condition to public effect.
Loss of sound order names the public consequence of defective rule.
Severing connection gives the corruption a concrete relational operation.
Kin relation identifies the social tissue on which the severing operates.

structural_cues: 47:22 places the disputed assumption-or-turning verb before land-level disorder and the cutting of kinship ties.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a branch for taking charge followed by corruption and severed kin; I infer that the focus disease predicts governance failure when inward weakness gains public agency. The live alternative is simple turning away, retained in the preceding model.

changed_reading.before: The diseased heart matters only as an individual's fear of fighting.
changed_reading.after: The private recoil may also diagnose unfitness for authority: once scaled through control of affairs, inward disorder becomes ecological and kinship damage.

context_deltas.mechanism: Later context moves from secret partial compliance to the extraction of concealed hostility and then to recognition through marks and slanting speech. The focus gaze becomes the first item in a disclosure system: inward disease leaks into look, visible sign, and vocal contour.

activation_trace.role: The focus seeing makes an otherwise interior condition observable.
A look that leaves pallor or defect visible supplies the first bodily signal.
Professed compliance supplies the overt surface beneath which a contrary condition may remain.
Partitioning compliance makes the profession selective rather than whole.
Concealment in the interior provides the hidden layer that later signs disclose.
Bringing something out of concealment supplies the transition from latent affect to evidence.
Causing the group to be seen confirms that disclosure can be mediated through visible presentation.
Recognition by trace or mark turns the bodily cue into interpretable evidence.
A visible sign by which condition is inferred extends the focus gaze into a semiotics of appearance.
An oblique vocal contour adds audible leakage to the visual signal.
Speech can signify beyond its explicit wording, allowing tone to disclose what the proposition conceals.

structural_cues: 47:29 and 47:37 repeat root ض غ ن without a branch inventory; they are used only as structural markers of concealed material paired with outward extraction.
47:26 hides selective obedience, 47:29 anticipates extraction, and 47:30 moves through showing, marks, recognition, vocal contour, and speech.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies secrecy, extraction, visible marks, recognition, and vocal slant; I infer that the focus gaze is an early diagnostic leak in the same chain. A live alternative is that 47:30 describes a broader class rather than the exact people seen in 47:20.

changed_reading.before: The deathlike gaze is a vivid but isolated simile.
changed_reading.after: The gaze is the first observable datum in a wider disclosure process through which selective compliance and concealed hostility become legible in body and speech.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later test is directed not only at persons but at their reports. This makes the focus request a report about the speakers' own readiness; exertion and patient restraint test whether that public self-description carries knowledge of the interior or merely circulates as speech.

activation_trace.role: Speech can state a held position, letting the request function as a self-description of commitment.
Reciprocal combat supplies the costly field in which the stated position can be checked.
Repeated testing that manifests condition turns the earlier request into auditable evidence.
Knowledge through disclosure supplies the epistemic result of the test.
Exertion under difficulty provides one behavioral measure of the spoken claim.
Holding the self against panic supplies the measure most directly opposed to the focus collapse.
A report that reaches inner reality lets the test audit whether public words match concealed condition.

structural_cues: 47:31 repeats testing around the disclosure of strivers, the patient, and the testing of reports, after 47:20 has already paired a public request with bodily evidence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies stated position, costly exertion, restraint, disclosed knowledge, and tested reports; I infer that the opening request reports the speakers' claimed readiness. A live alternative is that the reports are deeds or circumstances rather than speech claims specifically.

changed_reading.before: The request is only a desire for more revelation.
changed_reading.after: The request is also a report about the requesters; combat mention audits that report by making exertion and composure observable.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing context repeats the same extraction pattern outside direct combat: a summons to spend is pressed, withholding appears, and concealed hostility is brought out. The focus fighting mention is therefore one instance of a broader costly-call mechanism in which threat to body, property, or self-possession makes latent resistance visible.

activation_trace.role: Weak resolve provides the focus disposition that different costly demands can activate.
Loss of strength and slackened resolve explicitly names the state that the focus body displays.
Pressing a demand to its limit supplies the extraction pressure analogous to firm combat mention.
Withholding is the economic response that parallels bodily recoil.
Extraction from concealment makes pressure revelatory rather than merely punitive.
A verbal summons provides the broader class to which the requested combat command belongs.
Property leaving its holder supplies a noncombat form of costly compliance.
Repeated withholding shows the stable response produced when the summons reaches owned resources.
The self as one's own entity reveals that withholding finally turns back upon self-possession itself.

structural_cues: 47:37 repeats root ض غ ن without a branch inventory and pairs it with extraction; it is retained only as a structural echo of 47:29.
47:35 forbids weakened resolve, while 47:37-38 move from pressed request to withholding, outward disclosure, renewed summons, and repeated withholding.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies weakness, pressure, withholding, extraction, summons, spending, and self; I infer one costly-demand mechanism spanning body and property. The live alternative is that combat and spending test distinct dispositions and should not be fully assimilated.

changed_reading.before: The focus diagnoses a battle-specific fear of death.
changed_reading.after: Battle is one costly summons among several: when revelation threatens bodily or proprietary control, weak resolve leaks out as recoil, withholding, and concealed resistance.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the packet's non-dominant split mapping from the speech root to a root of smallness and agitation. It remains anchored at the opening speaking verb and is reinforced by the verse's later bodily disturbance, but downstream prose should present it only as a form-distant acoustic or kinetic echo, never as the direct translation of the verb.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The opening speaking verb at word 1 precedes the disturbed, deathlike looking at words 19-25.

activation_trace.role: The secondary mapping contributes bodily tremor from fear, making the opening speech latent with the reaction that follows.
Instability and oscillating movement let the request sound less settled than its propositional content suggests.
The visible bodily trace gives the form-distant agitation echo a focus-internal landing point.

changed_reading.before: The request is stable speech contradicted only later by fear.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the request already carries a tremulous instability that the later gaze makes bodily explicit.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because a revelation's descent is activated through a combat-specific branch of the same root. The doubled descent, explicit combat noun, and earlier meeting of sides keep it anchored, but prose should describe a latent performative resonance rather than claim that 'sent down' lexically means 'fight.'
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The doubled descent at words 5 and 8 is followed by reciprocal combat at word 13.

activation_trace.role: Coming down to meet an opponent turns requested revelation into a latent summons to enter the encounter it names.
Reciprocal fighting supplies the explicit focus anchor that licenses the combat resonance of descent.
The earlier meeting of opposed sides gives the descent-to-encounter resonance a visible contextual scene.

changed_reading.before: Revelation descends and then separately reports a duty to fight.
changed_reading.after: At a latent level, its descent itself becomes entry into the arena: asking that it come down is asking to be placed inside the encounter.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the packet's non-dominant mapped root of watering and transmission behind the seeing root. It remains anchored by the focus visual disclosure, the later causing-to-see, and the testing of reports, but it should be rendered as an exploratory link between sight and reportability, not as a lexical replacement of seeing with narrating.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The addressee sees the bodily response at word 14, making the hidden condition available as evidence.

activation_trace.role: The secondary mapping contributes transmission of a report, allowing the seen scene to carry knowledge beyond private perception.
The later caused seeing reinforces the idea that visual disclosure can become communicable evidence.
Knowledge of a report's interior truth gives the visually disclosed condition an audit destination.

changed_reading.before: The messenger privately notices a fearful look.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the act of seeing produces report-bearing evidence: the body narrates the interior condition before explicit testimony does.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates a branch about feigned death from the simple death noun in a simile. The look, public seeing, and focus contrast between request and incapacity keep a weak anchor, but downstream prose must say 'as if displayed incapacity' and must not accuse the figures of consciously faking terror.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The death simile at words 22-25 describes a look presented to the addressed observer after a public request.

activation_trace.role: A display of deathlike submission contributes the possibility that collapse functions socially as a claim of incapacity.
Appearance before other people makes the bodily state available as performance as well as symptom.
Actual loss of awareness remains the literal comparator and limits any performative inference.

changed_reading.before: The look transparently records involuntary terror.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the same look may also operate as displayed incapacity, a bodily way of withdrawing from the volunteered obligation without explicit refusal.

strongest_changes: The requested descent becomes an ordeal that turns a public claim of readiness into visible evidence of impaired resolve.
Earlier combat instructions bound the focus mention within phases of encounter, restraint, release, and cessation.
The deathlike gaze joins a larger disclosure chain running from secret selective compliance to visible marks and vocal slant.
The focus ending may remain syntactically open to the next ayah's obedience-and-truth prescription, while an independent threat reading remains live.
Later spending pressure generalizes the mechanism from battlefield fear to resistance under any costly summons.
summary.what_was_special: The focus ayah converts language into physiology: speakers ask for a bounded revelation, its mention of reciprocal combat tests the claim, and the heart becomes readable through the eyes. Context then extends that conversion across hearing, direction, authority, visible signs, tone, reports, and property without forcing those mechanisms into one final interpretation.
remaining_uncertainties: The relation between the final expression of 47:20 and the opening nouns of 47:21 can be continuous or sentence-final; both readings remain functional.
The packet does not force complete identity between those called believers at the opening and those diagnosed with diseased hearts later in the ayah.
The bodily response can indicate settled aversion, acute fear, impaired resolve, or socially displayed incapacity; only the last is deliberately contained as an outlier.
The two readings of the directional verb in 47:22 produce distinct mechanisms: retreat from guidance or diseased exercise of authority.
Split-root activations for speech and seeing are packet-licensed but form-distant and should remain exploratory resonances.
